name: Joshua Copeland
headline: Founder of ActionAtlas
about:
Versatile, top-tier, impact-driven IT & Digital Transformation Executive with over 10 years of 
experience in driving the development and implementation of business-led and customer-
focused enterprise-level technology solutions. Highly analytical with a combination of digital 
consultancy, agile frameworks, data architecture, project/program management, business 
analysis, QA, technical documentation, and team leadership skills. In-depth experience in 
blending visionary insight and sharp business planning skills to strategize major 
technological change initiatives and turnaround management. High-level expertise in 
ensuring cost-effective design, development, integration, implementation, testing, and 
maintenance of new services, tools, equipment, and systems to support long-term business 
objectives and requirements. Effectively executed major technology integrations and 
upgrades, technological transformations, and complex initiatives. Encourage innovation, 
implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, out-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, 
and creative problem-solving. 

Career Pinnacle
✔Serving in a key leadership role at Run Studios as Director of Information Technology & 
Facility Operations
✔Previously strengthened IT strategy and digital process innovation IT Manager. 
✔Partner with the Executive Leadership to lead the creation of the overall Strategic Plan for 
IT aligned with long-term goals and priorities.
✔Drive and champion digital process innovation and serve as a cross-functional change 
agent for the organization, optimizing operations and enhancing digital experiences. 
✔Highly experienced in strategic detail planning, design, execution, and leadership of 
enterprise-wide technology initiatives that supports business systems, strengthen 
departmental capabilities, and deliver continuous improvements. 
✔Recognized as thought leader in modern software and digital practices.
